architecture.name: Capture
architecture.body: Logix PLC tags through Optix and Node-RED into InfluxDB, bucket `Optix`.

architecture.name: Land
architecture.body: Python ETL every minute, only mapped tags, into `custom.InfluxRawPoint`.

architecture.name: Calculate
architecture.body: `usp_Oee_Calculate` writes `history.OeeMetricPeriod` by order, hour and shift.

architecture.name: Show
architecture.body: Optix reads live results through `usp_Oee_GetLive` and writes reasons back.

decisions.text: All downtime comes from events; PLC runtime counters only validate
Unrecorded time counts as unplanned downtime
Shifts stored in UTC; screens send and show local time
Events start as Unknown; the operator’s reason wins
A plan is a time budget; anything beyond it is unplanned
Reasons editable until end of the shift’s local day
Orders from Excel as Released; start, hold, complete in Optix

questions.question: When does a data gap become a “No data” stop?
Planned reasons without a plan
questions.recommendation: Allow only flagged reasons, with an optional cap

questions.question: Line OEE formula
questions.recommendation: A of last machine × P of bottleneck × product of Q

questions.question: Any lines with machines in parallel?
questions.recommendation: Treat all as series for now

questions.question: Line with no running order
questions.recommendation: Default machine order and cycle per line

questions.question: Line machine not in the order’s route
questions.recommendation: Excluded from line OEE for that order

questions.question: Where to log PLC validation
questions.recommendation: Validation table plus ETL log line

questions.question: Site time zone name
questions.recommendation: Windows name: SA Pacific Standard Time

questions.question: Link route steps to recipe steps
Imported order never assigned a line
questions.recommendation: Stays Released; cannot start without a line
